opening.argument: The presenter opens by promising instructions on how to use the app, and the screens show its earning, game-reward, and wallet features. Referral coins and game-based rewards appear as app functions, while the payment screen shows Paytm and PayPal not set and a $0.00 balance. That screen cannot establish a completed withdrawal or verified payment. The speaker’s five-dollar payment remark is unclear, and the description says the channel’s content is educational. Taken together, the observable material supports an app tutorial with unverified earning claims, not a demonstrated fraudulent solicitation by the creator.
